summary: The filing is a routine Form 8-K reporting an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering program. CapsoVision entered a Controlled Equity Offering Sales Agreement with Cantor Fitzgerald to sell up to $100 million of common stock at its discretion. The shares will be sold under an S-3 registration statement filed the same day. The filing includes the legal opinion of O'Melveny & Myers. This is a standard shelf takedown mechanism, not a special situation. No strategic event, premium, or deal terms apply. Watch for periodic disclosures of ATM sales, but no risk-arb angle exists.
